chart.title: Annual articles published in scientific and technical journals per million people
chart.subtitle: Includes physics, biology, chemistry, mathematics, clinical medicine, biomedical research, engineering and technology, and earth and space sciences.
chart.note: Articles are assigned based on the country of the first author's institution.

descriptionKey: Scientific and technical journal articles per million people are calculated by Our World in Data based on article data from the World Bank's World Development Indicators, and population estimates from the United Nations World Population Prospects.
